raw_segments.text: Exeter, scorn and defiance, slight regard, contempt, and anything that may not misbecome
the mighty sender doth he prize you at.
Thus says my king, and if your father's highness do not, in grand of all demands at large, sweeten
the bitter mock you sent his majesty, he'll call you to so hot an answer of it that caves
and wamby voltages of France shall chide your trespass and return your mock in second accent
